intent_snapshot.goal: Deliver controlled per-status-page inline custom_css and footer customization backed by status_pages.theme_config_json across Admin APIs/UI, D1 snapshots and scheduled fast guards, and isolated public main/history routes, as specified in docs/specs/status-page-theme-customization.spec.md.

acceptance.assertion: Source: BR-REQ-2. Per Spec A1, Admin status-page POST/PATCH/GET persist, partially merge, clear (null/empty to NULL), and return theme_config while rejecting enumerated unsafe or out-of-bounds custom_css, footer_text, and footer_hidden inputs with 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT before any DB write. Positive, boundary (16384/16385 and 200/201), and enumerated negative controls exercise the Hono route and schema seam. Agreed test seam: apps/worker/test/status-page-theme-admin.test.ts.

Source: BR-REQ-5. Per Spec A2, all 5 resolvers in status-page.ts, public status/homepage/artifact builders, /api/v1/public/status-pages/:slug/status, pre-deploy stored snapshot readers, and scheduled status/homepage fast guards carry isolated per-page theme_config, materialize defaults for pre-deploy snapshots, reject malformed stored theme_config, and invalidate on theme_config_json-only edits. Agreed test seam: apps/worker/test/status-page-theme-public.test.ts.

Source: BR-REQ-3. Per Spec A3, navigating StatusPage and IncidentHistoryPage/MaintenanceHistoryPage mounts #uptimer-status-page-custom-css via textContent, switching pages clears/replaces prior CSS immediately without cross-page leakage, unmounting to /admin removes the style node, and client defense-in-depth rejects enumerated unsafe CSS tokens. Agreed test seam: apps/web/src/app/statusPageCustomCss.test.ts.

Source: BR-REQ-4. Per Spec A4, StatusPage hides footer when footer_hidden is true, renders literal plain-text footer_text without HTML execution, falls back to Powered by {siteTitle} when unset, and StatusPageForm plus all 5 locales (en, zh-CN, zh-TW, ja, es) wire create/patch/clear/error states and homepageFromStatus. Agreed test seam: apps/web/src/components/statusPageThemeUi.test.tsx.

intent_snapshot.scope_size_reason: Per docs/solutions/adding-per-page-public-branding-field.md, any status-page public branding/theme field must atomically wire resolvers, Admin/Public/stored schemas, snapshot readers, fast guards, and Web consumers in one slice so snapshots and scheduled refreshes never diverge.

attestations.summary: Provenance verified (single parent 81c7b75, tree 0046cce); A1-A4 conform: strict Zod plus escape-aware CSS/footer validation runs before any DB access, all 5 resolvers fail safe through parseStoredThemeConfigJson, stored readers materialize defaults, both fast guards compare theme_config, client mounts CSS only through textContent with cleanup, and the footer renders as a React text child (inline bootstrap JSON already escapes '<'); blast radius medium: persisted public snapshot shape, scheduled fast-guard SQL/comparators, admin status-page write path.

advisory_findings.summary: The A1 seam test leaves out several Spec-enumerated negatives: '@/**/import', '\40 import', script tokens hidden by comments (e.g. 'java/**/script:'), and footer_hidden values "true" and 1. The code rejects all of them (comments are stripped and escapes decoded before matching; Zod requires a boolean), but no test pins them.

evidence.trigger: custom_css '@/**/import url(x)' or footer_hidden "true" sent to POST/PATCH /api/v1/admin/status-pages: the code correctly returns 400, but a regression in CSS_COMMENT_RE stripping would go undetected by status-page-theme-admin.test.ts

advisory_findings.summary: The fast-guard invalidation test only asserts null when theme_config_json changes. It has no matching-theme positive control, and nothing exercises homepage-guard-state.ts directly, so a null caused by an unrelated guard precondition would also pass.

evidence.trigger: Scheduled status/homepage fast guard with a theme_config_json-only change: tryCompute* returns null as expected, but the test cannot tell whether null comes from the sameStatusPageThemeConfig mismatch or from some other missing fixture field
